acceptanceCriteria: A test interrupts init and adopt after each activation step and asserts the next run either completes activation or refuses with a named reason, never both a stale marker and missing state.
Any partial-state finding is filed as a separate ticket citing the failing step.
body: Owner requested this on 2026-09-22 after reviewing google/ax (Apache-2.0) as prior art; this ticket records a test gap to verify, not delivery or promotion. Original Go work only; no source import. Prior art: internal/workspace/setup.go in https://github.com/google/ax prepares a workspace once, records a per-path marker only after every step succeeded, withholds the marker on any partial failure so the next start retries, and never redoes completed setup on a resume because that would destroy agent state. Current state: docs/specs/index-snapshot-v0.md lines 42-52 and 78-79 already make the index snapshot write atomic (temporary file, sync, rename) and index --if-stale handles staleness, so the snapshot itself is covered. What is not pinned by a test is the multi-file activation done by init and adopt (the .corvint directory, configuration, hook or plugin registration, and the first index) when the process is interrupted between steps: whether a later run sees a half-activated repository, and whether it retries or refuses. Write the interruption test; if it exposes partial state, file the fix as its own ticket under V1-0008 rather than widening this one.
title: init/adopt: verify an interrupted first run leaves no partial activation state and retries cleanly
